test_describe_numeric_series: test the Series.describe() method on integer data returns count, mean, std, min, quartiles, and max
test_describe_boolean_series: test the Series.describe() method on boolean data returns count, unique, top, and freq
test_describe_string_series: test the Series.describe() method on string data returns count, unique, top value, and frequency
test_describe_datetime_with_timezone: test the Series.describe() method on timezone-aware datetime data preserves timezone information
test_describe_timedelta_series: test the Series.describe() method on timedelta data returns count, mean, std, min, quartiles, and max
